_comment: Oracle EBS Cash Flow Analytics — Deployment Configuration
_instructions: REQUIRED: Fill in all null/empty values below before running deploy.sh. Values marked with *** CHANGE ME *** must be set for your target account.

redshift._note: *** CHANGE ME *** — Set to your Redshift cluster details. Clourformation will create this with the data you entered

oracle_ebs._note: *** CHANGE ME *** — Set to your Oracle EBS application server IP and ISG REST port
oracle_ebs.host: <ENTER YOUR Application HOSTNAME or LOADBALANCER DOMAIN NAME
oracle_ebs._secret_note: The secret is created automatically by deploy.sh (stage 0). It stores the EBS sysadmin password used by the Lambda for ISG REST calls.

zero_etl._note: *** CHANGE ME *** — Set source_arn to your Glue connection or DMS endpoint ARN for the Oracle source
zero_etl.source_arn: <ENTER THE ARN OF DMS Source Endpoint>
zero_etl.description: Oracle EBS to Amazon Redshift Zero-ETL integration
zero_etl._kms_note: OPTIONAL — Leave empty to use the default AWS-managed key. Set to a CMK ARN if you require customer-managed encryption for compliance. Create with: aws kms create-key --description 'EBS Zero ETL encryption'

agentcore._note: execution_role can be left empty — agentcore launch will auto-create one. Set model_id to your preferred Bedrock model.

ses._note: *** CHANGE ME *** — Set to a verified SES sender email address (or any address on a verified SES domain). This is the FROM address for dunning letters and payment reminders. Only the sender needs verification — recipients do NOT need to be verified.
ses._sandbox_note: If your SES account is in sandbox mode, you can only send to verified addresses. Request production access in the SES console to send to any recipient (https://console.aws.amazon.com/ses/home#/account).

vpc._note: *** CHANGE ME *** — Set to the VPC and subnets of your EBiz environment. Lambda functions will be placed in this VPC to reach the EBS ISG REST API. Use private subnets with a NAT gateway for outbound internet access to AWS services.
